description: The best performing posts of a range, ranked by one metric. This is the tool for 'what worked?'. Networks measure different things, so a ranking by impressions silently leaves out the networks that have none — rank by engagement to compare across all of them.

from_date.description: ISO 8601 date. Defaults to the last 30 days.

metric.description: Which metric to rank by. Defaults to engagement, the one every network reports.

name: get_top_publications
title: Get best performing posts
